comment: Manual read at https://flagaudio.com/vcv/electric-ensemble.html. That page is partly copied from the Tap Dancer manual and names the module 'Tap Dancer' in its Delay Line paragraph; the signal order it gives (saturation, two-pole low-pass with fixed resonance, delay taps, two-pole high-pass, mix) matches the arrows drawn on the Electric Ensemble panel, so it was used. The maker's input tooltips CV-Lp and CV-Hp were matched to the LP and HP knobs by panel position, not by index.
